title: Draughts
tagline: The world's oldest family of capture games
how_to_play: Move pieces diagonally and capture opponents by jumping over them. Men promote to kings with extended movement. Mandatory captures force tactical sacrifices.

variants.title: English Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Diagonal movement only. No flying kings. Free choice between captures.

variants.title: Turkish Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Orthogonal movement replaces diagonal. Majority capture rule. Immediate removal.

variants.title: International Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Flying kings. Mandatory longest chain. Men capture backwards. Delayed removal.

variants.title: Frisian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Movement is diagonal only; capture is in all 8 directions. Maximal capture is weighted, not counted: a king is worth more than a man but less than two men. A king may make at most 3 consecutive non-capturing moves while its owner still has a man.

variants.title: Lasca
variants.win: Leave the opponent with no legal move
variants.special: Emanuel Lasker's column game. Same stacking as Bashni but built on ENGLISH draughts: soldiers do not capture backwards, officers do not fly, and promotion ends the turn.

variants.title: Alquerque
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: A 25-point line board where not every point carries diagonals. Movement and capture both run along the drawn lines, so this is a graph, not a grid. There is no authoritative historical ruleset: the 13th-century source gives no rules.

variants.title: Russian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Men capture backwards. Mid-jump promotion. No majority rule. Free choice between captures.

variants.title: Brazilian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: International rules on 8×8 board. Flying kings. Majority capture. Delayed removal.

variants.title: Canadian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Largest standard board (12×12). 30 pieces per side. International rules. Longest games.

variants.title: Pool Checkers
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Men capture both directions. Flying kings. Mid-jump promotion. Free choice. US federation since 1966.

variants.title: Italian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Men cannot capture kings. Strict capture priority: king captures first, then most pieces, then most kings.

variants.title: Spanish Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Flying kings. Men cannot capture backwards. Majority rule with king preference.

variants.title: Czech Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: King captures take priority over man captures. Mid-jump promotion. No majority rule for men.

variants.title: Thai Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Only 8 pieces per side. Flying kings must stop immediately behind captured piece. Forward-only men.

variants.title: Bashni
variants.win: Leave the opponent with no legal move
variants.special: Russian Draughts with towers. A captured piece is not removed: it goes to the BOTTOM of the capturing column. Only the top piece of a column is ever captured, and whoever is on top owns and commands the column.

variants.title: Dameo
variants.win: Opponent has no legal move
variants.special: Phalanx movement: an unbroken line of men slides one square forward along its own axis. Men move diagonally and orthogonally forward but capture ORTHOGONALLY ONLY; kings move queenwise but capture rookwise. 18 pieces per side on all 64 squares.

variants.title: Diagonal Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Pieces start along the diagonal. The long diagonal of the board is empty at setup.

variants.title: German Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Men capture both forwards and backwards. Flying kings. No majority capture rule.

variants.title: Ghanaian Draughts
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Men do not capture backwards. No majority rule. A player reduced to one piece loses.

variants.title: Spantsiretti
variants.win: Capture or block all opponent pieces
variants.special: Russian Draughts rules on a wider 10×8 board. 15 pieces per side.
